BL-1391 — The reconcile resolves a conflict confined to append-only bookkeeping files deterministically instead of refusing, so a note appended by two roles or an abandoned_commits record never halts the coordinator for a human
What it solves: `required_wiring` anchor 1 is a consumer anchor: `handoffd.bb` is the
pre-existing live caller of the absorb ladder and the only process that
can emit the log line; a lib-only implementation that the daemon never
reaches fails it (BL-1235). Absent today.
Approval context: Minted on your "go ahead" of 2026-09-04 to my three-point proposal after you asked why you were getting so many deadlocks. This is point 2. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options: the bookkeeping set and the append-only rule are stated in the invariants and are deliberately narrow - any…
BL-1391 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1391" (or "reject BL-1391 <reason>") to act.
